newsitem.title: USA: TST says in trademark agreement with IBM.
newsitem.headline: TST says in trademark agreement with IBM.

text.p: TST/Impreso Inc said Wednesday it entered a trademark licensing agreement with International Business Machines Corp.

The company said the agreement involves the manufacture and distribution of a line of paper products within the United States, Canada and Mexico. It said the addition of IBM-branded paper to its product line could increase its future revenues significantly.
TSI/Impreso said it hopes begin shipping the products to retailers, paper merchants, wholesalers, office supply dealers and other marketing channels within the next 90 to 120 days.
The company said it could finance the IBM program through operating cash flows and bank credit lines but added it might need to raise additional capital longer-term to expand its production capacity.
